name: final_manifest

import os,resource; os.sched_setaffinity(0,sorted(os.sched_getaffinity(0))[:2]); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_CPU,(115,115)); resource.setrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_AS,(6*1024**3,6*1024**3));
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json,sys,subprocess
l=Path.cwd();excluded=['SHA256-MANIFEST.json','final_manifest.receipt.json','final_manifest.output.txt'];files=[]
assert json.loads(Path('frozen-after.json').read_text())['mismatches']==[]
for p in sorted(l.rglob('*')):
 if p.is_file() and str(p.relative_to(l)) not in excluded:
  b=p.read_bytes();files.append({'path':str(p.relative_to(l)),'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()})
s=json.dumps({'files':files,'terminal_noncircular_exclusions':{x:'Manifest self-reference or terminal runner receipt/output written after this manifest; preserved on disk, deliberately not self-hashed' for x in excluded},'status':'ACCESS_BOUNDARY_HOLD_NO_CREDIT','frozen_after':'13 checked, no mismatch; does not waive access concern'},indent=2)
subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(l/'write_lane.py'),'SHA256-MANIFEST.json'],input=s,text=True,capture_output=True,check=True)
print(json.dumps({'manifested_files':len(files),'manifest_sha256':hashlib.sha256(s.encode()).hexdigest(),'terminal_exclusions':excluded,'status':'ACCESS_BOUNDARY_HOLD; no formal dispatch or credit'}))
